* We tried to verify the app with Google, but the process required a paid assessment by an independent security lab. As this is a free project to help people clear spam, we have not proceeded with that paid assessment, so this app is not verified by Google. We do not sell your personal data or read or store email bodies. See the tutorial below for how to connect Gmail when Google allows it.

How to connect Gmail · Tutorial

If Google shows an unverified-app warning and offers this option, choose “Advanced”, then “Go to I Hate Spam (unsafe)”. Google may display the site domain instead. This is your decision, not a security certification. If access is blocked or this option is absent, you cannot continue this way; try the demo or Outlook.
